contract.principle: One contract; each fact has exactly one owner. Every other copy is checked against its owner and is never a second authority.

declarationShape.grammar: literal strings, non-negative decimal integers and nested plain tables only, inside one delimited block; no expression, so a nonexecuting parser reads exactly what the runtime reads
declarationShape.runtimeCheck: the runtime asserts that a format resultLimit equals MAX_TEXT_BYTES - 2 for the charge row and fails closed otherwise
declarationShape.contentClass: plain is the only class: the existing text contract. Markup is code-owned and never data.
declarationShape.cap: at most MAX_BASE_ENTRIES (64) declarations; the declared set equals the 28 current keys; no key is added

admission.U1: English base and packs are admitted only against declarations; SCHEMAS is derived from the format declarations
admission.U2: complete-English admission: every declared key needs one valid English entry. An undeclared English entry is rejected and counted (proposed base.undeclared). A declared key without valid English is counted (proposed base.missingDeclared) and resolves as today (unavailable, unknown_key). The whole-base 64-entry fail-closed rule is unchanged.
admission.packs: pack availability is unchanged: a plain pack with a valid autonym of at most 64 bytes and a plain entries table of at most 64 entries is adopted and offered. Completion never gates availability, and availability never implies completion.
admission.diagnostics: only additive Diagnostics() fields; every existing field keeps its meaning so current fixtures stay valid unchanged

contract.nonexecution: The offline tool never evaluates, imports or executes Lua, including to inspect declarations. Lua prototype tests may execute Lua in the synthetic harness; that is test evidence, not native evidence.
